caption: The drawing features a square composition with a beige, textured background. At the center, there is a large, green stem that curves and branches out diagonally from the bottom left to the upper right. Attached to the stem are four large flowers, each with red, rounded petals, green pointed leaves, and a yellow circular or oval shape at the center of each flower. The flowers are positioned so that one is located near the lower left, one near the upper left, one near the upper right, and one closer to the center. Several additional green leaves, elongated and pointed, extend from the stem's branches. The drawing is rendered in a flat, patterned style with each color area showing a faint crosshatch texture. The colors primarily used are red, green, yellow, and beige.
title: Tulip Pattern Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
